'''Slam Streever''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] scavenger who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]], scavenging for parts along with other scavengers like the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Blizz]].
